[[File:Shop.jpg|thumb|220x220px]]The '''Shop''' is one of the [[Map Locations]] and it is the primary way for the player to spend their [[Gold]].

== Wares for Sale ==
On [[Ascension]] 16+, shop prices are increased by 10%.

=== 5 Colored Cards (Class-Specific) ===
There will always be 2 [[Attack]] cards, 2 [[Skill]] cards, and 1 [[Power]] card.
* [[Common Cards|Common]]: 45 - 55 [[Gold]]
* [[Uncommon Cards|Uncommon]]: 68 - 82 [[Gold]]
* [[Rare Cards|Rare]]: 135 - 165 [[Gold]]
One of the cards will always be On Sale, reducing its cost by 50%.

=== 2 [[Colorless Cards]] ===
There will always be an uncommon [[Colorless Cards|Colorless card]] on the left, and a rare one on the right.
* [[Uncommon Cards|Uncommon]]: 81 - 99 [[Gold]]
* [[Rare Cards|Rare]]: 162 - 198 [[Gold]]

=== 3 [[Relics]] ===
The [[Relic]] on the right will always be a [[Relics#Shop|Shop Relic]]. This is the only source of [[Relics#Shop Relics|Shop Relics]].
* [[Relics#Common|Common]]: 143 - 157 [[Gold]]
* [[Relics#Uncommon|Uncommon]]: 238 - 262 [[Gold]]
* [[Relics#Rare|Rare]]: 285 - 315 [[Gold]]
* [[Relics#Shop|Shop]]: 143 - 157 [[Gold]]

=== 3 [[Potions]] ===
* Common: 48 - 52 [[Gold]]
* Uncommon: 72 - 78 [[Gold]]
* Rare: 95 - 105 [[Gold]]

=== Card Removal Service ===
* Can only be used once per shop.
* Costs 75 [[Gold]] initially, increases cost by 25 [[Gold]] every time it is used at any shop.

== Interactions ==
* {{R|The Courier}}: When you buy a [[Cards|Card]], [[Relics|Relic]], or [[Potions|Potion]], it is replaced by a random item of the same type. In addition, all purchases have a 20% discount. This stacks multiplicatively with Membership Card (for a combined 60% discount), except for card removal (which takes the better discount).
** The Colorless cards may be replaced by a colorless card of a different rarity, however, and the Shop Relic will be replaced by a Common, Uncommon, or Rare relic.
* {{R|Membership Card}}: All shop items and services have a 50% discount. Stacks with {{R|The Courier}}.
* {{R|Smiling Mask}}: The Card Removal Service now always costs 50 gold.
* {{R|Meal Ticket}}: Whenever you enter a shop room, heal 15 HP.
* {{R|Maw Bank}}: If you buy an item at the shop, this relic is disabled and no longer provides 12 Gold per floor. This includes the card removal service.

==Merchant==

{{character_simple|image1 = MerchantWithProps.png|caption1 = Buy Something!}}The '''Merchant''' is the friendly NPC who sells items at the Shop.

===Description===
The Merchant is a blue skinned man sitting on a blue-green rug next to some [[cards]], a small chest, a bag, and a knife. He is wearing a mask covering his face (similar to the {{R|Smiling Mask}} [[Relic]]) and a blue cloak. He is friendly towards the player, if not a little rude and brash, and talks to them while they view and purchase his wares, mostly small talk, or statements revealing his greed.

===Trivia===
* In the game's soundtrack, the music which plays while the player is visiting the Shop is titled "Meet the Merchant". 
**This could be a reference to the Meet the Team videos for Team Fortress 2.
* One of his quotes "I used to be like you" suggests he was similar to the players in some manner in the past. It is implied, since this quote is only shown in [[Act 4]], that the Merchant was once also a puppet of [[Neow]]. Of course,  it could also just be a reference to the memetic ''Skyrim'' NPC quote "I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee."
*One of his quotes, "Stay a while and listen", is a reference to, and direct quote from, Deckard Cain from the Diablo series.
*One of his quotes, "It's dangerous to go alone! Give me all your gold!" Is a reference to the original Legend of Zelda when the old man at the start of the game gives the character a sword saying "It's dangerous to go alone! Take this."
